description: This PHP class extends Symfony's UrlType form component to create a custom URL form input with additional options for pre/post addons and row class styling.

classes.name: Goteo\Util\Form\Type\UrlType
classes.description: A custom form type extending Symfony's UrlType to add optional addons and styling options for URL input fields.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the block prefix used for this form type, here 'custom_url'.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Configures default options for the form type, adding 'pre_addon', 'post_addon', and 'row_class' with default empty string values.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Specifies the parent form type, which is Symfony's UrlType.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Modifies the form view variables to include custom styling and addon HTML, based on options.
